small.role: labels, units, context and soft keys

medium.role: editor values and selected list entries

provenance.type: Three roles proposed by Joe; nominal primary text heights observed in public GIN source, not verified TE ink metrics or an official stock scale.
provenance.color: GIN reference RGB values; secondary is an original library choice. Not measured TE/OLED calibration.
provenance.safeArea: Bottom clearance responds to Joe's case/window observation and Kennel's documented 12px composition lift; 16px is a proposed starting inset.

rules.guidance: Use Small, Medium or Large; shorten, format, wrap or paginate instead of shrinking below Small.
Faithful host typography uses a local stock font with its hash, available glyphs and named spacing profile; schematic mode cannot validate stock typography.
Map Latin text to lowercase SVG IDs; uppercase IDs are icons. Reject missing glyphs explicitly.
Author at 320x160 logical units, distinguish physical output and framework offsets, and check stroke extents against proposed safe margins.
Use Blue, Green, White and Orange in physical order, reinforced by labels and positions; document normal, Shift and page maps.
Parameter names and values share a deliberate edge anchor; editor columns preserve encoder order. Measure value and unit as one baseline-aligned group in the selected font.
Keep selected, current, draft, applied and saved states distinct; show complete destructive targets and only real recovery actions.
Use original explicit supported SVG geometry, stable checked IDs and separate filled contours; no browser-only features in native assets.
Prefer prebuilt named blocks, visibility changes and small live layers; publish mutations only when state changes and stop cosmetic updates at idle.
Retained geometry is not pixel caching. Use pixel caches only where the exact runtime supports their lifetime and paint-order contract.
Separate antialiasing, curve tessellation and temporal smoothing. Preserve useful curves and subpixel geometry; host smoothing does not qualify native output.
Measure native peak GUI/audio deadline cost separately from host counts; keep graphics out of audio and interrupt callbacks.
Keep TE code, firmware, fonts, extracted geometry, kerning databases and stock artwork out of public source and hosted files.
